'''Horizon Media Group''' is the media arm of [[HN Group]], telling stories for the group and the businesses it works with.<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/companies Our companies], hngroup.org.uk.</ref> Alongside [[Horizon Network]], it is one of the two businesses HN Group brings together.

== Activities ==
* '''Media and content''' — content and media for the group and the businesses it works with
* '''Press enquiries''' — media and press enquiries to the group are directed to Horizon Media Group through the HN Group contact form<ref>[https://hngroup.org.uk/contact?topic=media Contact], hngroup.org.uk.</ref>

== Structure ==
Horizon Media Group is part of [[HN Group]] and sits alongside [[Horizon Network]]. Its staff use email addresses at '''media.hngroup.org.uk'''. [[Horizon Advertising]] is a subsidiary of Horizon Media Group, but is managed by Horizon Network.

* [[HN Group]]
** [[Horizon Network]]
*** [[Horizon Development]]
** '''Horizon Media Group'''
*** [[Horizon Advertising]] (managed by Horizon Network)

== Brand ==
[[File:horizon-media-group-roundel.svg|thumb|The Horizon Media Group roundel]]
Horizon Media Group's logo is a thick indigo ring containing the initials '''HM''', alongside the company name. The roundel is also used on its own and as an app icon.
